name: Shimmick Corporation Common Stock
summary: Shimmick Corp. is engaged in delivering infrastructure solutions that help critical markets across water, energy, climate resiliency, and sustainable transportation. It is involved in completing complex water and other critical infrastructure projects, ranging from advanced wastewater recycling and purification systems to dams, locks, and transit systems. The firm’s infrastructure projects are focused on water and wastewater treatment, water resources, and other critical infrastructure. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Irvine, CA.
